summary: Checkboxes are primarily referenced throughout the student prerequisites module as the utility used to visually indicate Boolean states such as YES/NO, or the completion of forms. The CheckedYES method is specifically used for rendering true states, such as completed forms, issued ID cards, and confidentiality confirmations. The Checkboxes logic is embedded in display formatting, data export, and backend validation across immunization, occupational health, infection control, and confidentiality records for students and staff.
purpose: To provide a standardized, reusable method for representing and checking Boolean (true/false, YES/NO) states in system workflows, especially for student prerequisites, safety, and compliance documentation.

workflows.name: Student Prerequisite Validation Workflow
steps: Display IDCard, ConfidentialityForm, ImmunizationFeePaid, MedicalCompleted, and other Booleans using Checkboxes.CheckedYES()
Validate dates and codes for immunization, infection control, and safety
On update, set Boolean fields and persist using Checkboxes logic
Export or display formatted content using Checkboxes for YES/NO

workflows.name: Staff Confidentiality and Safety Update Workflow

business_rules: Checkboxes.CheckedYES() is used wherever a Boolean field requires visual or export confirmation of a YES/NO state
If a form or record is not completed, the field shows blank or NO
Dates must be valid and within allowed ranges for each prerequisite
Completion (YES) must be validated before persisting
validations: Dates for prerequisites must be properly formatted and within maximum allowed years
If a Boolean field is marked YES using Checkboxes, underlying logic must confirm prerequisite met
Expiry dates must be on or after completion dates
If a mask size is specified, fit test date must be present
calculations: Expiry dates for immunization and mask fit tests (e.g., add years to completion date)
Formatting of dates and YES/NO output for reporting
conditions: If form not completed, show blank or NO
If prerequisite met, Checkboxes.CheckedYES() returns YES
If expiry date is more than 5 years past, show warning
system_behavior: Checkboxes provide visual representation and formatting for Boolean fields
In exports, Checkboxes.CheckedYES() translates Boolean values to YES/NO
Validation routines reference Checkboxes logic to block invalid/incomplete updates
dependencies: Database procedures for updates and retrievals
exceptions: If required dates or Boolean fields are missing, validation fails and update is blocked
If a prerequisite is not valid, Checkboxes show blank or NO and system prompts correction
content_gaps: There is no explicit standalone Checkboxes class definition; all references are for utility methods and display logic.
No information about how Checkboxes are rendered outside of backend/display (e.g., UI implementation details).
